tool_input.prompt: Current minor version of PostgreSQL 16 and latest major version

tool_result_content:
The current minor release of **PostgreSQL 16 is 16.15**. It is supported until November 9, 2028.

The latest major version with a general release is **PostgreSQL 18**, whose current minor release is **18.6** (first released September 25, 2025, supported until November 14, 2030). The page also announces **PostgreSQL 19 RC 1** (release candidate) as of October 15, 2026, but that is a pre-release, not a final major version.
